A '''T-6 Diodem''' was a type of home appliance unit which could also be built into [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] or [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. [[Mag Doum]] once illegally sold these items to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at a ten times markup.
